svg.aria-label: Three schematic ECG strips for hyperkalemia. Normal. Peaked T waves. Conduction changes: flat P wave, long PR interval, wide QRS. Treatment is calcium first, then shift potassium into cells, then remove it.

tspan.tspan: Also on ACEP’s list: bradycardia, junctional or
IV. Repeat the ECG at 5 minutes; repeat
units (naive or CKD) or 10 units, with D50
1–2 amps; glucose at 30 min, then hourly.
Calcium steadies the heart but does not
lower K+. Insulin and albuterol only shift it,
so reassess K+ at 2–4 hours and plan
